verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer/Autofix feature automatically scans incoming issues, finds root causes, and automates triage in the background, and can review PRs on GitHub/GitLab without manual intervention — both are genuinely autonomous background automations. However, this is a fixed built-in capability rather than a general framework where AI-native users configure arbitrary custom autonomous automations, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of Seer's autonomy in practice. Missing for 10: user-configurable autonomous agent workflows beyond the built-in Seer/Autofix, independent evidence of reliability of unattended operation, and detail on how broadly automations can be customized.
